chunks: Al-Nawfali, from al-Sukuni, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: concerning
A slave who intentionally kills his master—he said: “He is to be killed for him.” Then he said: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله ruled accordingly.”

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله; source of the ruling
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: a slave; the legal subject mentioned in the case
key_terms.قَتَلَ: killed; indicating the act of homicide
key_terms.قَضَى: ruled or judged; indicating a legal judgment
key_terms.مَوْلَاهُ: his master; the victim in this ruling
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ بِهِ: he is to be killed for him; indicating retaliatory execution

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave intentionally kills his master in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intentional homicide by a slave against his master. It states that qisas applies in this case, and attributes this ruling to the judgment of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.
